maserati-grecale.note: Grecale Modena rear with boomerang tail lamps and quad exhausts. UK car; number plate blanked by the photographer.

maserati-grecale.note: 2026 Grecale Modena V6 cabin (Auto Zürich 2026): digital clock on the dash, stacked central touchscreens. Other show cars are blurred behind the windscreen.

maserati-granturismo.note: 2026 GranTurismo Trofeo cabin at Auto Zürich 2026; other show cars visible only through the windscreen.

maserati-grancabrio.alt: Maserati GranCabrio (second generation) in dark green-grey with the soft top up, front three-quarter view
maserati-grancabrio.note: Second-generation GranCabrio (2024 on): GranTurismo II front end with the fabric roof. German-registered car (plate KN-GC 490).
